personalizeFeed.question: How can you personalize your feed?
personalizeFeed.answer: Your feed adapts based on your searches, favorites, and interactions. The more you use the app, the more relevant suggestions become.

buyItem.question: How do you buy an item?
buyItem.answer: Open the listing, tap Buy, choose delivery or in-person handoff, then confirm payment.

saveSearch.question: How do you save a search?
saveSearch.answer: After applying your filters, use Save search to get notified when new matching items are posted.

chatMember.question: How do you chat with a member?
chatMember.answer: Tap Message from a listing to ask your questions before buying.

favorites.question: How do you add an item to favorites?
favorites.answer: Tap the heart on a listing. You can quickly find your favorites later.

makeOffer.question: How do you make an offer?
makeOffer.answer: If enabled by the seller, use Make an offer to propose a different price.

reserve.question: How do you reserve an item?
reserve.answer: Some sellers accept reservations through messaging or with a dedicated option.

bundle.question: How do you buy a bundle?
bundle.answer: Contact the seller or use a bundle option (if available) to group multiple items.

trackOrder.question: How do you track your order?
trackOrder.answer: Go to My purchases to view tracking and delivery details.

itemMismatch.question: What if the item does not match the listing?
itemMismatch.answer: Report the issue from your order with photos and a clear explanation.

cancelPurchase.question: Can you cancel a purchase?
cancelPurchase.answer: Yes, but only before shipment or confirmation.

findItems.question: How can you find items more easily?
findItems.answer: Use filters, categories, brands, and location to narrow down your search.

manageListings.question: How do you manage your listings?
manageListings.answer: In My listings, you can edit, pause, or delete your listings.

sellingBasics.question: What are the basics for selling well?
sellingBasics.answer: Use clear photos, an honest description, a fair price, and reply quickly.

postListing.question: How do you post a listing?
postListing.answer: Tap Sell, add photos, description, category, and price, then publish.

payments.question: How do payments and transfers work?
payments.answer: Funds are secured and transferred after the transaction is validated.

listingRemoved.question: Why can a listing be removed?
listingRemoved.answer: A listing may be removed if an item is prohibited, non-compliant, counterfeit, or misleadingly described.

shippingReturns.question: How do shipping and returns work?
shippingReturns.answer: Instructions are sent after a sale. Returns may be available under Bloomi conditions.

proAccount.question: Professional seller account (if enabled)
proAccount.answer: You may get specific tools such as more visibility, advanced management, and business options.

tips.question: Recommended tips for you
tips.answer: Bloomi may suggest tips or guidance based on your activity.

manageProfile.question: What can you manage in your profile?
manageProfile.answer: Photo, bio, personal info, notifications, security settings, and preferences.

verifyIdentity.question: Why verify your phone number or identity?
verifyIdentity.answer: To secure transactions and reduce fraud.

signUpSignIn.question: How do sign-up and sign-in work?
signUpSignIn.answer: You can create an account with email, phone, or another available method. Your password can be reset.

accountBlocked.question: Why can an account be blocked?
accountBlocked.answer: Because of rule violations, security concerns, or unusual activity.

ratings.question: How do ratings and stars work?
ratings.answer: After a transaction, each member can leave a review.

privacy.question: What should you know about data privacy?
privacy.answer: You can manage your settings and control some visible profile information.

security.question: Security and reports: the basics
security.answer: Report suspicious behavior and avoid off-platform payments.

referrals.question: Referrals
referrals.answer: Some referral features may exist depending on app updates.

policies.question: Bloomi terms and policies
policies.answer: Usage rules and policies are available in the app.

suggestions.question: Personalized account suggestions
suggestions.answer: Recommendations may appear based on your usage.

contactSupport.question: How do you contact Bloomi support?
contactSupport.answer: Use the Help center or email contact@bloomi.ch.

report.question: How do you report a user or listing?
report.answer: Use the Report button from a profile, listing, or conversation.

prohibited.question: Which items are prohibited?
prohibited.answer: Illegal, dangerous, counterfeit, or non-compliant products are not allowed.

staySafe.question: How can you stay safe on the app?
staySafe.answer: Stay within Bloomi messaging and avoid sharing sensitive information.

bug.question: What if the app has a bug?
bug.answer: Update the app, restart your phone, or check your connection.

termsOverlay.title: Terms of use
termsOverlay.body: By creating an account or using Bloomi, you agree to our Terms of Use and Privacy Policy. You agree to treat other users with respect, not to post any illegal, misleading, or inappropriate content, and to follow our safety and moderation rules. Reported content may be reviewed and removed.
